description: For a user who HAS a list of business locations and wants to sell it on LocationLists. Free, nothing is stored. Give what the list is (one sentence), about how many rows, and the price they have in mind in US dollars: the result says whether that price holds up against our ladder and the closest lists already on the site, what the seller would keep (80%), and the price we would list it at. Prices end in 9, $9 to $999. Then sell_list hands the file over. The same check in a browser: https://locationlists.com/sell.

rows.description: About how many rows (locations) the list has

target_usd.description: The price the user has in mind for the whole file, US dollars

what.description: What the list is, in the user's words: 'Florida marinas with slip counts, from marina websites and county records'

name: price_my_list
title: Price a list the user wants to sell (free)
